title: mcp-attest suite
description: A portable conformance suite for MCP servers. Any harness that can open an MCP session and compare a decision with an expectation can run it.

name.description: What the suite is called, e.g. "orders-authorization".

description.description: One line about what the suite checks.

target.description: Where the server is. A harness may override it.

url.description: URL of a server speaking Streamable HTTP.

command.description: Command that starts a server over stdio.

identities.description: The principals the suite presents, and what each of them may do.

headers.description: HTTP headers this identity presents. Values may reference the environment with ${VAR}.

env.description: Environment variables this identity passes to a stdio server.

expect.description: What this identity may and may not do. A tool that is in neither list is denied.

deny.description: Tools this identity must never call.

conditional.description: Rules that carve an exception out of a blanket allow or deny.

allow_when.description: Argument conditions. A plain value means equality; a value ending in / means prefix; a value containing * means glob.

cases.description: One explicit expectation about one call.

probes.description: Arguments for tools whose schema cannot be trusted to produce a harmless value.

oauth.description: What the server's OAuth layer must look like. Omit it when the server does not use OAuth.

signing_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the HS256 signing key. Needed for the claim-level probes; without it they are skipped, never passed.

rules.description: The rules this suite covers. A harness that does not implement one of them must say so.

metadata.description: Free-form provenance: author, date, OWASP test identifiers.
